text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S's warrior journey of 
self-discipline was finally drawing to a 
closeâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hup...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: ...Does anything feel off with your body?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――No problem. ――I'm fine. Besides... I've 
come to understand it myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Through all the training up to today— my 
body has—finally grown a little stronger.

I nod firmly in agreement with her words. 
The quality of her running has become 
dramatically sharper and flawless since 
her debut...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Well then, it is finally time—
choice_data_list:
Yeah. It's time to take on the challenge 
toward our "revolution"!

Yeah. It's time to take on the challenge 
and start a "revolution"!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —There's a race... I want to challenge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"To demonstrate my strength—and bring 
about the 'revolution'— the goal I must 
achieve in victory... is—"

To display extraordinary strength and 
bring about a "revolution." Considering 
that was her mission, setting her sights 
on the Nippon Derby was inevitable.

"A once-in-a-lifetime stage to determine 
the best in Japan of that generation. The 
winner of this race, without exception, 
has their glory etched into history as the 
strongest of their era—"

As the curtain-raiser for the 
"revolution," there could be no race more 
fitting than this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—That makes it much easier. ...Impressive, 
as always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Then—regarding the plan for the Japanese 
Derby— ...Allow me—to make a proposal as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The Aoba Sho. —A "milestone"... I want to 
enter it... as an intermediate goal.

The Aoba Sho is a GII race held at Tokyo 
Racecourse, the very same venue as the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

Because the distance is 2,400 meters—the 
exact same as the Japan Derby—it serves as 
a prep race to test their aptitudes. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Jinx. ...I am aware of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No Umamusume who has won... the Aoba 
Sho... has ever gone on to win... the 
Derby.

As Symboli Kris S said, throughout 
history, no Umamusume who won the Aoba Sho 
has ever gone on to win the Japan Derby.

There are many theories that running 
another 2,400-meter race so soon after the 
first is simply too much of a burden for a 
Classic-class Umamusume, but—

No one has been able to pinpoint the exact 
cause. As a result, the reality persists 
that people continue to call it the "Aoba 
Sho Jinx."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Even without precedent—I will win. That is 
the strength... to carry out a 
"revolution."

Symboli Kris S's unwavering words 
instantly sobered my own resolve. To live 
up to that fierce will of hersâ
choice_data_list:
—Understood. Let's get results in the Aoba 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: And let's win the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

And so, with the Japanese Derby as our 
ultimate goal, we set out anew toward its 
trial race, the Aoba Sho...!

The next day. While I was in the Trainer's 
office reviewing the training plan for the 
Derby—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Terribly sorry to interrupt your work, 
Trainer <username>. ...I'd like to speak with you 
briefly regarding Kris S.
choice_data_list:
I don't mind, but what in the world is 
going on...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's nothing like that. There's no 
trouble. ...I just came to express my 
gratitude to you once again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Kris S told me yesterday that she plans 
to take on the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At the time, I asked her. 'Are you 
confident you will win?'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She answered matter-of-factly. "It will be 
a tough race. The probability is still 
low." However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Right after, she also said this: 'Together 
with my Trainer, I will do what must be 
done, and victory will be ours'... she 
said.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In those words... I clearly saw the change 
in her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"As you well know, Kris S is strong. She 
possesses a calm, resolute, and 
unshakeable spirit, carrying out her vows 
entirely on her own."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However, that was until recently—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Her steadfast spirit remains unchanged, 
yet with renewed vitality, she aims for 
greater heights with more power than ever 
before—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That vitality probably comes from... 
feelings for someone who affirms who she 
is and walks closely by her side."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—In other words, it must be their trust in 
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If she were still the same as when we 
first met, I'm sure words like that never 
would've crossed her lips. ...To do 
something 'together' with someone, that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to you, Kris S can walk her own 
path with confidence, staying true to 
herself. ...Please, continue to look after 
her."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall take my leave— ...May glory 
shine upon the path you walk.

The words Symboli Rudolf gave me instilled 
the courage I needed to walk the path 
ahead...
—At the same time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Condition, good. —Onto the next set.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. Seems you're steadily gaining 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't be more delighted. Please 
continue to brighten this era that I run 
in with such vigor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Gimlet. —What is your business?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— You have already boldly proclaimed to 
this world what your mission is.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In contrast, for me to allow silence 
toward you to be deemed a misunderstanding 
would be an injustice as one who shares in 
this fleeting epoch, would it not?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have come to reveal it. The 
true intention behind my descent upon this 
mortal realm!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hear this! Or engrave it into your mind! 
I will run the Satsuki Sho! The NHK Mile 
Cup! And the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby)! Every single one of them!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And—with every single stride I make, I'll 
drive this world mad, drunk on my 
splendor!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All will be dazzled by the fleeting 
brilliance of mine... And worship my 
eternal strength to the point of utter 
ecstasy—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, pure fanaticism...! Kris S! I shall 
grant you permission to receive that heat 
from the closest vantage point!”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...This rotation... is far too brutal. 
Not just the Satsuki Sho and the Derby— 
but the NHK Mile Cup as well...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Going so far... What you aim for— your 
goal—... Is it really that frenzy?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Impressive as always. Peering even 
beyond the true motive, are you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Then let me tell you. What I strive for 
is an indelible mark born beyond the 
limits of frenzy—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It is my "proof to the world."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Raison d'être――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Behold. A future where I shall prove who 
I am, more brilliantly than anyone 
else...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Now, our little chat is over. Next, on 
the battlefield... you'll understand what 
my words meant.

Symboli Kris S shared with me what had 
happened between her and Tanino Gimlet 
today...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I want to hear—your opinion. Why does 
Gimlet—choose such a grueling—rotation?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Her "Raison d'être"... What does proving 
it really mean...?

...It was an exceptionally difficult 
question. But upon hearing Tanino Gimlet's 
race rotation, a single hypothesis formed 
within my mind.
choice_data_list:
Maybe this is proof of your inborn 
"talent".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Potential...?

First, as a premise, in the Classic 
Class—especially in spring—most Umamusume 
have not fully developed their bodies...

Which is why, in races during this period, 
a girl's raw, innate "talent" becomes a 
major factor that determines the outcome.

Keeping this discussion of "potential" in 
mind, looking at Tanino Gimlet's race 
rotation begins to reveal the true 
intention behind it—
choice_data_list:
...Are you confident you can win at 
1,600m?
...Are you confident you can win at 1600m?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...This is extremely difficult. My 
aptitude... should be geared toward medium 
and long distances. To overturn that... 
would be nearly impossible.

"Yes. An Umamusume's distance aptitude 
stems from her innate 'potential.' It 
isn't something that can simply be altered 
through training."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...! I see—Gimlet is—

It seems Symboli Kris S is arriving at the 
same hypothesis. Looking again at Tanino 
Gimlet's race rotation—

"After the Satsuki Sho, Tanino Gimlet 
takes on the consecutive challenge of the 
1,600m NHK Mile Cup and the 2,400m 
Japanese Derby..."

Running a 1600m race that demands natural 
speed, followed by a 2400m race requiring 
well-rounded strength. A challenge 
stretching from the mile to the Classic 
distance.

This is unmistakably the "MC Rotation"— 
the conceptual race rotation that became a 
hot topic when a challenger attempted it 
last year...!

What if she manages to produce remarkable 
"results" in these two races?

"It proved that the Umamusume's innate 
'talent' held the supreme radiance—"

That dazzling radiance will surely serve 
as a magnificent guiding light for the 
horse girls of the future...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"That is—what Gimlet strives for—the 
pure... proof of her 'genius'...—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"No... it is likely correct— My 
intuition—understands it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I understand, but— what I must do—my 
mission—remains unchanged.
choice_data_list:
...You're right. No matter who we're up 
against, nothing changes.

...Yeah, you're right. No matter who the 
opponent is, nothing changes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —First up is the Aoba Sho.

Eyes fixed solely on the steadfast goal 
held firmly within our hearts— we now took 
our steps toward the Aoba Sho.
